newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy parl't body to hear ex-Olivetti's Passera.
newsitem.headline: Italy parl't body to hear ex-Olivetti's Passera.

text.p: The industry commission of Italy's lower house of parliament has set for next Tuesday a hearing with former Olivetti chief executive Corrado Passera, parliamentary sources said.
The following day, Wednesday, the commission will hear testimony from chairman of the Consob Bourse authority, Enzo Berlanda.
The hearings are part of an inquiry by the commission into the accounts of the troubled information and technology company.

Passera resigned from Olivetti in June. His name was on Thursday added to a list of people associated with the company who are being investigated in connection with Olivetti's first half 1996 accounts.
